scope.parity: Pinned original checkpoints; selected synthetic decisions, not task accuracy.
scope.tetris: Three seeds (1,2,3), 20 pieces each, batch4, same candidate descriptions and policy. Timings exclude model loading and include scoring all landing candidates.
scope.quantization: Q8 symmetric absmax blocks32, f32 norms/readout; SemIf fidelity gate max absolute dp0.05 plus identical argmax and exact tokens.
scope.referenceTiming: PyTorch fallback recurrence used for reference scores. Its timing is not an optimized SemIf baseline.
